meta.note: Trees as [x, z, kind, surveyed] (surveyed 1 = a NYC 2015 Street Tree Census or OpenStreetMap tree, 0 = synthesised). kind: street = Midtown street trees (honeylocust, Callery pear, ginkgo, Sophora, pin oak, linden: 8-15 m, light open canopies, one per 6-8 m of kerb in a small square pit); plane = London plane (Bryant Park allees, avenues: 20-25 m, broad, mottled bark); elm = American elms (the Mall in Central Park, four rows forming a cathedral vault, 20-25 m, vase-shaped); park = Central Park woodland (mixed oak, maple, tupelo, 15-25 m, dense; synthesised on a jittered 4.2 u grid where OSM maps none, open meadows left clear). Trees inside the ring venue box (ring.ringClearTrees in nyc_layout.json) are left out.
